The Milky Way in 3D

Every star sits where its measured parallax puts it. Drag to tilt and spin (one finger on touch moves), Shift-drag or right-drag to move (two fingers on touch tilt and spin), scroll or pinch to zoom — all the way round, even underneath. Press 3D to flip between overhead and side-on. Click anything, then zoom, to dive straight into it. Keep zooming out — or tap LG, LAN and OBS — to reach the edge of the observable universe. Zoom in on the Sun and you drop straight into the Solar System. Or take the whole journey, starting at Earth.
